registryEvidence: Gujarat Revenue Department first-party material identifies the Settlement Commissioner & Superintendent of Land Records, lists online rural Record of Rights through AnyRoR and urban property cards through e-Milkat, and links the Mehsana collectorate. The official DoLR page lists Gujarat's RoR portal. Kadi Municipality is listed by the official Mehsana district site. This evidences a state/local cadastral custodian and service leads, but not an open parcel feature response.

officialSources.observation: Official Gujarat Revenue Department page: Settlement Commissioner & Superintendent of Land Records is a department head; online rural RoR points to AnyRoR and urban property cards to e-Milkat; H Branch covers survey, settlement, and city survey.
Official Any RoR landing page exposes View Land Record - Rural and View Land Record - Urban links; rendered page requires JavaScript.
Official Department of Land Resources page lists Gujarat's RoR Web as AnyRoR and distinguishes textual RoR from spatial cadastral records.
Official Mehsana district site identifies Kadi Municipality; this is locality evidence, not a parcel geometry service.

source: Gujarat Revenue Department / AnyRoR and e-Milkat service leads, with DoLR and Mehsana district corroboration
